layout.arrangement: Minimal section-title slide: a large light-gray content rectangle with a thin dark-red border sits inset on a white page background, occupying roughly 4%-96% horizontally and 8%-98% vertically. A single large bold red title is centered horizontally and slightly above vertical center inside the gray rectangle. A small yellow circular slide-number badge with purple outline sits in the top-right corner of the gray rectangle.

layout.hierarchy: The red title overwhelmingly dominates (largest, boldest, most saturated element). The yellow number badge is the only other element, tiny by comparison. Everything else is empty gray space.

visual_elements.description: Large light-gray rectangle forming the slide's content panel, outlined with a thin (1-2px) dark-red/maroon border. No fill texture or gradient.
visual_elements.position: center, spanning nearly the full slide with a white margin around it

visual_elements.description: Slide-number badge: small ellipse/circle filled pale yellow with a purple outline, containing the dark number '13' centered inside.
visual_elements.position: top-right corner inside the gray rectangle

visual_elements.description: Small gray mouse-cursor arrow overlapping just below the tail of the title text (recording artifact, not part of the slide design).

imagery: No photos, illustrations, or decorative icons besides the small yellow slide-number badge; a stray mouse cursor appears near the title from the screen capture.
typography_notes: Title is a bold sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-like), very large (~54-60pt equivalent), sentence case with capitalized words, colored bright red. The slide number '13' is a small dark sans-serif numeral. No italics, no all-caps, no bullet lists anywhere on the slide.
animation_state: No mid-build state; this is a static section-divider/title slide with only the title and slide number visible. The mouse cursor near the title is a capture artifact, not an animation element.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to white (#FFFFFF). 2. Draw a rectangle covering ~4%-96% width and ~8%-98% height; fill light gray (#E6E6E6), border dark red (#990000), border weight ~1.5pt, no shadow. 3. Inside the rectangle, add a centered text box (horizontally centered, vertically ~45-50%): text 'Transformer Building Blocks', font Arial Bold, ~54pt, color bright red (#CC0000), single line, no bullets. 4. In the top-right corner of the gray rectangle (~90-95% width, ~10-16% height), draw a small ellipse ~0.5in diameter: fill pale yellow (#FFFF99), outline purple (#9933CC) ~1pt; add text '13' centered inside, Arial ~12pt, dark gray (#333333). 5. Do not add any other text, bullets, or images. 6. (Optional, for pixel fidelity only) the tiny gray cursor arrow near the title is a recording artifact and should be omitted from the recreation.
